push.title: W 3-0 vs Jebem Ti Kruha | You: 7.4 (11th worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.4, PhogsToffees. Even the best barbecue gets a little charred sometimes.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at Jebem Ti Kruha's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 3 of 3 shots on target. That's composure in front of goal.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ A goal against Jebem Ti Kruha. You didn't hesitate, and the keeper didn't stand a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. That's a performance people follow.

WORK ON
- 67% passing (2 of 3, down from your usual 75%). Small change, big gain: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. That's a coach's honest word.
- 0.5 below your average. Even the sun takes a cloudy day off.
- Goals per shot on target: 33%. You're knocking on the 60%+ door.

Five-minute drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Listen here, PhogsToffees: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

Small fixes, big changes. - Coach Lasso
